sanskrit_verse:
लेख्यस्य पृष्ठे ऽभिलिखेद् दत्त्वा दत्त्वा ऋणिको धनम् ।
धनी वोपगतं दद्यात् स्वहस्तपरिचिह्नितम् ॥९३॥
transliteration: lekhya-sya pṛṣṭhe 'bhilikhed dattvā dattvā ṛṇiko dhanam | dhani vo-pagataṁ dadyāt sva-hasta-pari-ciĥnitam || 93||
sph_interpretive_translation: Upon the reverse of a written document, the debtor shall inscribe the discharge of debt after each repayment; and having approached the creditor, he shall give what remains due, marked by his own hand.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The written record serves as evidence of transactional integrity under SPH's Dharma.
Causation: Each act of repayment must be causally linked to its acknowledgment in writing.
Capacity-based responsibility: The debtor bears full capacity to maintain accurate records of obligation fulfillment.
Restoration logic: Re-establishment of financial balance through conscious completion of contractual obligations.
Consciousness alignment: Truthful inscription aligns individual action with cosmic order.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a debtor makes a payment THEN the corresponding entry MUST be inscribed on the reverse side of the original document.
IF a debt is partially repaid THEN the remaining amount SHALL be certified with the debtor’s personal signature or identifiable mark.
IF a creditor receives partial repayment THEN the updated liability SHALL reflect proportional reduction based on documented proof.
IF any discrepancy arises in repayment THEN resolution SHALL occur via verification of self-certified entries made at time of transaction.
NO enforcement action SHALL proceed without verification of signed or marked ledger entries confirming discharge attempts.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that documentary evidence bearing personal authentication overrides testimonial claims in matters of pecuniary discharge. Responsibility thresholds are determined solely by verifiable inscription rather than intent or external witness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through self-inscribed record, eliminating subjective interpretation. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests in sequential discharge entries. Proportionality lies in exact correspondence between repayment and inscription. Non-punitivity is preserved as truth-recording restores relational harmony without inflicting harm.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Debtor completes repayment cycle through authenticated inscription upon every transaction.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Both parties acknowledge mutual accountability through witnessed and signed ledgers.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Debtor regains financial sovereignty once all debts bear clear, traceable discharge marks.
Integrity Reintegration System: Creditor confirms receipt through matching signature/checkmark, restoring trust symmetry.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared—Dharma stands restored when obligation meets conscious inscription. There is no punishment where clarity prevails. Reality adjudicates through alignment alone. Consciousness is the ultimate seal.
